title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department
description: Touka Kuroitsu is a research assistant who belongs to the Monster Development Department of the evil organization Agastia. However, the enemy she has to fight right now isn’t the heroes of justice, but her boss.So long justice exists, evil too, will exist. This is the story of those who fight secretly in the shadows of justice and evil’s confrontation.

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x1
episodes_data.description: Touka Kuroitsu, an assistant in evil secret society Agastia's monster development department, must do whatever she can to push a project proposal through.

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x2
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu accompanies Megistus on a business trip to Kyushu, where she realizes Megistus's dedication to his job.

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x3
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu creates a new monster, Hydra, to take out Blader. Unfortunately, budgetary concerns have caused most of the new monster's functionality to be omitted... and Blader appears to be in a big hurry!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x4
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu hopes to acquire pluripotent cells from Camula, Agastia's strictest executive. But it isn't until she attends an idol concert on a related matter that she finds her chance!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x5
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu's team needs a stamp of approval from each of Agastia's executives to get their latest request fulfilled. But terror (and frustration) awaits at each of their lairs!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x6
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu wants to create a special monster for Valentine's Day, but Akashic repudiates her lack of a proper feminine mindset. And so, the chocolate-making class begins!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x7
episodes_data.description: The development department holds a drinking party, and Camula shows up! The party's organizer, Kuroitsu, seeks a way to break free from the awkwardness, but...

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x8
episodes_data.description: Magical Girls Pilia Magia infiltrate Agastia and end up in a showdown against Megistus. Meanwhile, Kuroitsu seeks a breakthrough in her battles against Blader...

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x9
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu comes up with a new plan: to defeat Blader in underwater combat! Through various traditional beach games, Kuroitsu will test the aquatic potential of her monsters!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x10
episodes_data.description: Agastia's latest monster, Mummy, has Blader on the ropes... until a particular sight takes away her will to fight. Mummy wants to reject the role she was designed for and create a new lifestyle. But can a monster without a voice make a life... as an idol?!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x11
episodes_data.description: Kuroitsu tags along on a retreat for Agastia executives in order to learn more about what makes them tick. But while the team enjoys their hot springs resort trip, an unexpected enemy seeks to take advantage of the relaxed atmosphere!

episodes_data.title: Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department 1x12
episodes_data.description: Zet Arc is attempting to buy out Agastia! But when the takeover turns hostile, who will appear to join Miss Kuroitsu in the fight?!
